**About:** Vidbyte CLI: start hosted Research harness runs, run local Codex coding-agent teams, and get ranked next actions from your terminal.

- Install the CLI: `pipx install vidbyte-cli`
- Install the agent skills: `npx skills add cerredz/vidbyte-cli`
- Agent skills guide: https://vidbyte.pro/docs/cli/agent-skills
- Research harness (hosted on Vidbyte's servers): https://vidbyte.pro/docs/harnesses/research
